title: Panel renders the real skills by stage, with an honest empty state
goal: Kaji's watermelons · skills shows the real store, or says there is none
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the skills panel and pre-flight skill plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok", real data).

renderSkills in web/public/dashboard/dashboard.js (about line 892) fetches /api/skills and lists the skills of the chosen tab (Seed | Sprout | Ripe | Dropped, Create | Try | Use | Dropped in the simple theme) with the stage counts on the tabs, each row showing id, version, status, and the latest evaluation as with-skill against baseline counts; the "Planned · not connected yet" text is gone

With no skills the panel says exactly "No skills yet. Create one with nerv skills stage <package.json>"; a failed request shows the error, not an empty state; no fake skills outside tests (the demo data of the old dashboard is not reused)

A test across the join (failing first): a skill staged in a temporary home with src/skills.ts shows in the served dashboard's panel on its stage tab, and an empty home shows the empty-state text; it follows the existing dashboard test pattern and the style guide (docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md: tokens, voice) with no new literal colour
The panel stays read-only: promotion and rollback stay on the CLI (owner approval), no buttons are added
privacy: Neutral invented skills, fleets, spots and weather only; no owner data, tokens or coordinates of a real place in Git or tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one render function, one fetch and a join test, following renderMelons. Not a measurement.
